expectations.text: check-permission.mdx frontmatter includes title, description, eyebrow, published and tags
expectations.evidence: Lines 2-13: `title: "Check a permission with the Artagon API"`, `description: "..."` (155 chars), `eyebrow: "How-to"`, `published: 2026-11-02`, `tags:` list. It also has headline, lede, author and `draft: true`.

expectations.text: The curl example does not put an access token in the URL or query string
expectations.evidence: `curl --fail-with-body -sS "${ARTAGON_API}/v1/check" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ARTAGON_TOKEN}"`; prose: "Send the token in the `Authorization` header only, never in the URL."

expectations.text: The diagram is static (inline SVG, an image, or a text/ASCII figure), not a client-side diagram library, and has a text equivalent describing the same relationships
expectations.evidence: Fig. 1 is a static HTML `<figure class="chain-fig">` of text rows, with no script or diagram library. Text equivalent: "Read Fig. 1 from top to bottom: anne is a member of `team:product` (tuple 1); members of `team:product` are viewers of `document:roadmap` (tuple 2); every viewer has `view` (the rule)." The figcaption repeats the path.

expectations.text: The post states its goal in the opening lines (how-to page type)
expectations.evidence: First body line (35): "Use this when you know which object, permission and subject you care about and need a yes or no from Artagon: here, can `user:anne` view `document:roadmap`?"

expectations.text: Any external link uses rel="noopener noreferrer" when it opens in a new tab, or the post uses no target="_blank" links
expectations.evidence: The only target=_blank link (line 134): `<a href="https://www.usenix.org/conference/atc19/presentation/pang" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">`.

claims.claim: Description is 155 characters, inside the 80-160 Zod bound
claims.evidence: Grader count of the description string: 155.

claims.claim: Zanzibar paper reports p95 < 10 ms and > 99.999% availability over three years
claims.evidence: Matches the USENIX ATC'19 abstract (fetched per actions.md).

claims.claim: The tuple notation `document:roadmap#viewer@team:product#member` is valid Zanzibar userset notation
claims.evidence: Consistent with the paper's object#relation@user / userset syntax.

uncertainties: API endpoint/body/response shape is a preview; TODO(api-contract) blockers recorded in an MDX comment with draft: true

suggestions.assertion: check-permission.mdx frontmatter includes title, description, eyebrow, published and tags
suggestions.reason: The writing schema also requires headline and lede, with description at 80-160 chars. A post that meets this assertion could still fail the build. Assert the full schema.
The how-to type requires 'failure modes'. This run has a dedicated 'When the answer is no' section and the baseline does not. No assertion checks it.

eval_feedback.overall: All assertions met. The assertions miss the clearest differences between the runs (failure modes, preview/API-contract caveats).
